# 9 Learning Objectives Check

Use this checklist for self-assessment.

---

## 9.1 Technical Competencies

I can …

- [ ] methodically classify a time series (measurement process, sampling rate).
- [ ] validate a time series (sorting, duplicates, missing values).
- [ ] apply resampling appropriately (aggregation vs. interpolation).
- [ ] distinguish between Rolling Mean and EWMA and choose appropriately.
- [ ] conceptually separate trend and seasonality.
- [ ] generate and interpret lag features.
- [ ] interpret autocorrelation.
- [ ] define anomalies globally and locally.
- [ ] implement baseline forecasts.
- [ ] evaluate forecast models using MAE.

---

## 9.2 Comprehension Questions

1. Why is the sampling rate crucial for interpreting seasonality?
2. When is interpolation problematic?
3. Why can a trend artificially increase autocorrelation?
4. Why are baselines methodologically important?
5. How does a structural break differ from an outlier?

---

::: {.callout-tip title="Note"}
If several points are unclear, review the corresponding chapters
and work on the exercises.
:::
